q: He said to me, “By God! I shall support you.”
o: He swore by God that he will support me
He swore by God that he will have supported me
He swear by God that he would have supported me
He swore by God that he would support me
e: শপথসূচক By God indirect-এ swore by God দিয়ে প্রকাশ হয়। Shall বদলে would হয় (reporting verb past), I বদলে he এবং you বদলে me হয়। তাই “He swore by God that he would support me” (সে ঈশ্বরের নামে শপথ করে বলল সে আমাকে সমর্থন করবে)। ‘will’ বা ‘will have’ কাল ভুল, আর ‘swear’ past-এর জায়গায় ভুল রূপ।
